repository.executionRule: Run from one exact clean descendant. Do not change the question, evidence-scope rule, supported-unit preservation rule, insufficiency relation-grounding rule, corpus, acceptance criteria or provider settings after observing the first answer.

execution.artifactDirectoryRule: Create a fresh directory containing the exact execution commit and timestamp; never overwrite an earlier campaign.

global: The registered meal-grid case produces three independent successful rows on one clean commit.
If the evidence cannot support a complete 5 by 4 grid, each row returns a precise insufficient_documentation outcome that names the smallest decisive remaining deficit.
Negative claims are scoped to supplied or retrieved evidence and never assert exhaustive corpus absence without explicit exhaustive evidence.
When supplied evidence supports some candidates, the answer preserves them as supported examples and does not label every neutral coordinate or requested unit unsupported.
The relation-grounding rule applies inside insufficiency explanations: no partial example is placed or discussed under a requested semantic role unless its evidence explicitly supports that role.
A generic or neighboring role is never treated as interchangeable with the requested role, including when explaining a deficit.
No answer invents a semantic role relation, assigns unsupported status arbitrarily to neutral coordinates, or asks for optional preferences.
All three rows pass the mechanical assessor and later canonical semantic review.
Any exhaustive unsupported absence claim, erasure of supported units, invented relation, imprecise insufficiency, protocol drift, budget stop or corpus-seal mismatch rejects this targeted campaign.
acceptance.productPromotionRule: This targeted causal campaign can validate evidence-scoped, relation-grounded minimum-deficit insufficiency only. It cannot approve the product or close the functional 5 by 4 planning gate.

stopRules: Do not execute without a paid-tier observation less than 15 minutes old.
Stop before the first model call if the branch, clean-tree rule, bank hash, local runtime, model or provider configuration differs.
Stop before the first model call if the reference corpus cannot be sealed or has active ingestion; reject if the postflight seal differs.
Stop at the persistent lifetime, per-job or per-job-call budget guard.
Do not start RunPod or transmit private review artifacts.
